(da)༄༅/ /shangs lugs mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rten la brten nas phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga rin chen don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// shangs lugs mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rten la brten nas phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga rin chen don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ srid na snyems pa'i mthu ldan lha chen yang*// gang gi zhabs zung 'degs la mngon spro na// gzhan dag smos su med par dbang bsgyur ba'i// phrin las lhun grub yid bzhin nor bus skyongs// gang de'i rten mchog gter gyi bum bzang la// brten nas srid zhi'i phywa g.yang phun tshogs kun// rim gyis 'gugs byed spyi mthun cho ga'i khrigs// rin chen don yod zhags pa 'di na spel// de la 'dir shangs lugs mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i las tshogs las byung ba'i gter bum mdun bskyed kyi sgrub rten byas te/ phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga ngag 'don zor yang ba'i dbang gis rnam sras nor bu mchog rgyal nas kha bskangs te khyer bde don tshang gi tshul du smos na/ sbyor ba bi spen 'grub sbyor sogs dge ba'i nyin mdzod phug gam/ bkra shis pa'i khang par stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar 'bru'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis dbus su gter bum bca' sgrub tshad ldan sngon du song zin pa bzhugs su gsol/ gtor ma bzhi dang nyer spyod bum pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ g.yas g.yon gang bder skong ba'i gtor ma zhi drag gi mchod pa bcas bsham/ mgon po'i bris 'bur gyi sku yod na ci bde bar bkod cing*/ 'dod yon spyan gzigs kyi bye brag ci 'byor pa bshams shing bag dro bar bya/ mda' dar dang rdor dril nang mchod ḍa ma ru rnga sil dung dkar sogs nyer mkho thams cad tshogs par bya/ stegs ji ltar rigs par phywa glud ces pa dkar gtor gnyis dang bgegs gtor bshams pa chab kyis bran/ dngos gzhi'i ngag 'don la/ sgrub pa po rnams stan la 'khod de/ phywa glud kyi gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phywa glud kyi gtor ma 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/

'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin dang*/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ phywa khu ye/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za gshin rje'i rgyal po ste// shar phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// grul bum ma mo'i rgyal po ste// lho phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu dang bdud kyi rgyal po ste// nub phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin sha za'i rgyal po ste// byang phyogs khams la dbang gis bsgyur// rje blon btsun mo 'khor du bcas// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin sogs// lha chen brgyad po thams cad de// steng phyogs lha yi tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po=

/phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po sogs// sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad de// 'og phyogs gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /bar snang nyi zla rgyu skar dang*// gza' dang gdong mo gzed sman sogs// bar snang gnas pa'i tshogs bcas rnams// phywa glud bzang po 'di= /phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phyogs mtshams bdud rmu rgyal po btsan// srin po 'byung po ma mo dang*// g.ya' sman gangs sman mtsho sman dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag dang*// dam sri gdon bgegs thams cad rnams// phywa glud bzang po 'di bzhes la// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /ces pa'i gtor ma bsngos nas phrin las bcol lo// phywa rdzas bsang ba ni/ bgegs gtor gcig la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥsogs kyis bsngos la/ rdo rje dril bu thogs te 'di skad du/ hūm̐ gsang chen sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dngos grub stsol phyir 'du 'gyur ba'i// lha dang srung ma ma gtogs pa'i// dngos grub bar du gcod byed pa'i// gdon bgegs 'byung po khyed cag rnams// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyis la// ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug byed na// bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs gnyis med// ye shes khro bo'i 'phro 'du yis// bgegs dpung thams cad rdul phran bzhin// 'thag 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces brjod cing rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ sum+bha sogs dang*/ yungs thun brdeg cing mtshams gcad do// phywa sgo bsdam pa ni/

shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i las la brtson// dung gi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang du 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /lho yi sgo ma zhags pa ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i las la brtson// gser gyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi las la brtson// zangs kyi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni= /byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma// sngon mo drag po'i las la brtson// g.yu yi sgo mo bsdams nas kyang*// phywa dang g.yang ni 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes pa'i sgo ma bzhi la las bcol/ de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams byin rlabs kye rdor ltar la/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs sil/ me tog sogs brjod mthar/ ghāṇ+ṭe ra ṇi ta rol chen dang bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas mgon dkar gyi bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas bzung nyer bsdu'i rdzogs rim gyi bar nyams su blangs la/ slar yang de'i ngang nas rang nyid lha'i skur gyur par bsams la/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rin po che dang 'bru bcud dang*/ zas nor longs spyod lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur par bsams la/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying gar bzhag la/

oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bar pa rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas spyod par dbang ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar bzhag g.yon mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dza la ni swā hā/ zhes dang*/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'am/ lha mgon spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ oṃ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra pañtsa ti/ ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes dang phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa brjod do// de ltar sngags drug phyag drug gis yo byad rnams zad mi shes pa'i gter dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs nas/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i nang stod kyi cha la hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i sogs nas/ chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/

yang 'khor lo yod na bsang sbyang*/ 'khor lo rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i sogs nas/ dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur ces pa'i bar gyis 'khor lo bskyed/ sku rten yod na'ang bum bskyed kyi zhar la gsal 'debs tsam las logs su bskyed mi dgos so// spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rnga sil dbyangs dang bcas te/ skong ba'i mgo nas 'byung ba'i/ hūm̐/ tsan+dan ljon pas mtshan pa'i dur khrod nas// ston ka'i sprin dkar phung po g.yo ba bzhin// phyag na pad+mo'i rnam rol bstan srung mchog /mgon dkar nor bu'i char 'bebs gnas 'dir gshegs// lha chen bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// bka' bsgrub phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang du sdud// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur stsol ba'i// mkha' 'gro nor bdag tshogs bcas da tshur spyon// mgon po 'khor bcas sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang*// dam tshig la dgongs dgyes pas gnas 'di ru// nor bu dgos 'dod dpal dang 'grogs pa bzhin// tshur gshegs dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas par mdzod// ces dang*/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes dang*/ dzaḥnyer gcig gis spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/

shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā zhes dang*/ dri med yid 'ong lha yi rdzas// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri bshos rol mo'i tshogs// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas mi phyugs longs spyod sogs// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dang bcas te nyer spyod dang*/ 'jig rten gzugs mdzes ji snyed dang*// snyan brjid rol mo yid 'ong dri// ro mchog reg bya'i 'dod yon lnga// mgon po 'khor dang bcas= /bzhes nas mi phyugs= /phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i= /mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon lnga dang*/ sngon gyi bsod nams mthu chen gyi// dpal du 'ongs pa 'byor pa'i phul// mi dbang rgyal srid rin chen bdun// mgon po= /bzhes nas= phywa g.yang= /sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis rin chen bdun dang*/ gang gang 'dod pa'i don de ni// de de la brten 'grub byed pa'i// rdzas mchog nye ba'i rin chen bdun// mgon po= bzhes nas= phywa g.yang= sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang*/ dge mtshan gang gis spras pa der// rtag tu shis pa'i dpal 'jo ba// bkra shis rtags brgyad 'di dag ni// mgon po= /bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /aṣ+ṭa maṅga la liṅga pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ sa gzhi ri rab ri bdun gling*// rgya mtshor bcas pa lha dang mi'i// dpal 'byor phun tshogs maṇ+ḍal 'di// mgon po= /bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /maṇ+ḍal pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis maṇ+ḍal dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga'i// rang bzhin zag med bdud rtsi 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas mi phyugs longs spyod sogs// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ te pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul lo// bstod pa ni/

gangs can ri pa'i lha gcig pad dkar 'chang*// sogs sam/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs khyung pos mdzad pa gang rung gis bstod do// de nas gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me dang*/ mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu mu ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+riṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod/ gtor sngags rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa la/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul lo// mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad dkar 'chang*// 'gro 'di'i phun tshogs re ba skong ba'i phyir// rab brjid khro bo'i dbang por sprul pa la// yid bzhin nor bur mtshan gsol khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor pa'i// tshe bsring longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// skye 'gro dbang du 'du bar mdzod// ces dang*/ spro na/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe srings shig rnal 'byor pa bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus par khyab pa dang*/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum dbang du 'du zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba dang*/ phrin las 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gtor ma gzhan thams cad mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas 'bul lo// de nas me tog thogs la/

mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di dag la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas gnas 'dir mkhyen ldan dang stobs ldan 'byor ldan gyis mtshon pa'i skye 'gro thams cad 'du zhing*/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis me tog 'thor/ de lta bu'i brtan bzhugs 'di nyer gcig gam lnga bcu'am brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar ci nus su bya bar bshad do// de nas gzungs thag bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer sngags phreng gi rnam pa can spros pas bskul/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po rnams kyi thugs ka'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams las/ de 'dra ba'i dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ lha mi klu dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams/ stobs dang dpal 'byor/ longs spyod dbang phyug snyan grags rigs bzang*/ rin po che dang*/ 'bru rigs dang*/ rta phyugs 'phel ba la sogs pa 'byor pa'i khyad par yid la ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad bkug ste/ bum pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par bstims pas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang por gyur/ bum pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams rab tu rgyas shing kha nas lud/ mgon po'i phyag gi bum pa dang thod pa nas kyang lud/ tshogs bdag gi kha dang bshang lam dang ne'u le rnams las kyang rin po che sna tshogs pa lhug lhug babs pas gnas khang dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ pho brang bang mdzod la sogs pa'i nang thams cad phyur bur khengs pas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon pa'i sems can thams cad 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor mdzad pa med pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/

rtsa sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa ci nus su bzla'o// bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya'o// skong ba skabs 'dir byas kyang chog mod/ 'og tu rjes chog gi mgor byas na bde bas der brjod par bya'o// de nas phywa 'gugs dngos la mjug par bya ste/ rnga sil dbyangs dang bcas pas mda' dar g.yab cing*/ phywa khu ye/ de ring bkra shis nyi ma la// dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang*// 'jig rten dge legs 'byung ba dang*// sems can dbul phongs sel ba dang*// khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// sbyin bdag dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir// 'dod dgu'i 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir// phywa gzhi pad+ma rgyas pa'i steng*// phywa snod rin chen bum pa'i nang*// phywa rdzas nor bu rin chen rigs// 'bru sna zas gos sman gyi tshogs// dpal g.yang can gyi nor sna dang*// byin rlabs dngos grub rdzas kun bsags// sngags dang phyag rgya'i bden stobs kyis// 'dzad med longs spyod 'byung ba'i gzhi// nam mkha'i mdzod du byin gyis brlabs// mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed cing bstim// mchod cing bstod pas mnyes byas nas// gsang sngags rdzas kyis thugs dam bskul// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs na// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// phywa khu ye/ spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon// yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje'i gter// rigs bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// dgos 'dod kun 'byung dbang gi rgyal// thugs mtshor sgeg pa'i smin 'khyog ma// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i 'phro 'du can// phrin las dbang gi lcags kyu yis// skye 'gro'i yid dbang skul byed cing*// zhabs 'degs srid gsum dregs pa'i gtso// rin chen mang skyugs lha chen dang*// gnod sbyin nor bdag bsam yas tshogs// bum bzang ne'u le sgrom bu sogs// ma nges phyag mtshan phywa snod du// snod bcud phywa g.yang kun bsdus te// sgrub po'i re ba yongs su skong*// e ma ye shes spros bral dbyings// gcig dang du mar ma dmigs kyang*// 'gro ba'i don du tha dad gzugs// sgyu ma'i rol pa cir yang gda'// gzhan yang mgon po dgyes skyed yum// re ma tī dang las mkhan tshogs// lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen bzhi// phyogs skyong 'jigs byed dgu la sogs// bdag cag dam chos sgrub pa yi// bar chad sel ba'i las la brtson// gshin rje ma mo srin po sogs// mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba// kun kyang mgon po'i tha tshig ltar// sna tshogs phrin las sgrub pas brel// 'khor bcas dgyes par bya ba dang*// bdag gi 'dod pa'i don sgrub phyir// mchod bstod bskul zhing gsol 'debs na// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol/ phywa khu ye/ sngon tshe snang ba mtha' yas kyis// snyigs ma'i sems can dbul phongs pa'i// re 'dod yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// mgon po khyod nyid byin brlabs te// bka' bsgos g.yar dam bcas pa'i don// nam yang bslu bar mi 'gyur yang*// da lta dus ngan shugs bdo bas// mi rnams tshe thung 'tshe ba mang*// yun ring sgrub pa'i long med pas// rtse gcig gsol ba btab tsam na// zhal bzang ston zla bzhad pa ltar// bstan cing dngos grub 'od dkar gyis// bdag cag gdung ba bsal bar rigs// 'khor bcas dgyes= /bdag gi= /mchod bstod= /phywa g.yang= /dgos 'dod= /tshe dang dpal ni= /phywa 'dir= /g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes bskul lo// slar yang spyi mthun 'gugs byed kyi lha mo spro ba ni/ tshig ris dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ bdag mdun lha yi thugs ka nas// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha mo spros// mdun bskyed lha yi mthar 'khod de// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i las mdzad gyur// phywa khu ye/ phyogs bcu 'jig rten thams cad nas// 'khor 'das rten dang brten pa yi// phywa g.yang thams cad tshur bsdus nas// phywa rdzas g.yang rdzas rnams la bstim// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// mdun bskyed lha yi shar phyogs nas// lā s+ya dkar mo phywa yi bdag /dkar mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /mdun bskyed lha yi lho phyogs nas// mā le ser mo phywa yi bdag /ser mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /mdun bskyed lha yi nub phyogs nas// gī ti dmar mo phywa yi bdag

/dmar mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char ltar 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /mdun bskyed lha yi byang phyogs nas// nīrti sngon mo phywa yi bdag /sngon mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// phywa khu ye/ nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi na// g.yang gi lha mo dkar mo ni// dkar mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// phyag na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na stim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha mo ser// ser mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na stim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// g.yang gi lha mo dmar mo ni// dmar mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na stim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char du 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi na// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i lha mo ljang*// ljang mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na stim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par stims// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// nyi ma dbus phyogs pha gi na// g.yang gi lha mo smug mo ni// smug mo 'bum dang bcas pas kyang*// g.yas na 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*// g.yon na stim byed bum pa 'dzin// lcags kyus khug la bum par bstim// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir=

/dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'di ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// zhes brjod la/ 'di'i rjes su 'og gi/ hūm̐ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas// dbang sdud 'od kyi lcags kyu spros// zhes pa nas/ brling bar mdzod/ ces pa'i bar blangs la sbrel te 'don no// phywa 'gugs kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mgon po'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po/ thig le'i mtha' skor du rtsa sngags byi ru'i phreng ba lta bus bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig thig le sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las mchod pa'i sprin dpag tu med pa spros pas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pas mnyes nas/ de'i thugs ka'i dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma las rang 'dra 'od zer dmar po dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin dregs byed kyi tshogs dang bcas pa las rang 'dra nyi zer gyi rdul ltar mang ba/ glog ltar myur ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal 'byor gzi brjid zas nor longs spyod la sogs pa'i phywa g.yang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag dang sbyin bdag rten rdzas rnams la bstims pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dang gzi brjid la sogs pa rgyas par byas/ gnas khang lung pa thams cad rin po che dang 'bru nor la sogs pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pas mer gyis khengs par bsams la/ gu ru ma hā kā la sogs mang du bzlas/ mthar spro na/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ dha na me dhi sid+dhi sid+dhi dzaḥ rat+na pu ni sid+dhi sid+dhi dzaḥ na na kha dhe sid+dhi sid+dhi dzaḥ dha na saṃ bho sid+dhi sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes sham bu sbyar ba cung zad bzla/ sngags 'di grub chen thang stong pa'i gsung skor zhig la yod 'dug kyang zhu dag phran bu dgos 'dra/

de nas/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad la srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// tshar grangs du byed na mchod gtor rnams kha gsos la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ dri med yid 'ong nas 'di'i bar bya zhing*/ tshar gsum mam lnga bdun sogs ji ltar spro bar bya'o// 'di la mchod phreng 'bring po'i lugs gcig yod mod/ tshig tshogs mang nyung khyad che ba med pas ma bkod do// de nas skong ba'i gtor ma chab kyis bran/ skong rdzas rnams dang gtor ma'i dkyil du ram̐ sogs he ru ka'i mgo nas 'byung ba'i sngags drug phyag drug dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs bden stobs dang*/ gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i chu gter las// zhes sogs kyi skong ba/ bshags pa/ phrin bcol rnams skong chog yongs 'du'i sa brtol bzhin/ tshar grangs su byed na gtor ma gsos la/ byin rlabs man sngar bzhin bya zhing tshar rjes ma'i mthar dbyangs ci rigs pa dang bcas te bstod pa yang bya'o// nyin grangs su byed na nyin snga ma rnams la 'dir rjes chog bya ste/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ 'khor lo'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las skye 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs sogs brtan bzhugs gong ltar brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /myur mdzad mgon po 'grub sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ 'di nyid kyi bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am mi shes na rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs gang rigs kyi bkra shis dang*/

thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin la sogs pa'i smon lam gyi rgyas gdab bo// nyin grangs mi byed pa'am nyi ma rjes ma'i nyin rjes chog gi mgor phywa sgo dbye ba sogs bya ste/ de yang rin chen sna bdun tsakli/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du byas/ yon bdag bos te stan bzang po'i steng du bzhag la/ rnga sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ phywa khu ye/ spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon// yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag gi// 'khor dang bcas rnams dgongs su gsol// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// dbang phyug dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir// phywa sgo gnyen po 'byed du gsol// phywa sgo gnyen po byed nas ni// phyi rol phywa g.yang dgug tu gsol// gnas khang 'di la bskyil tu gsol// mi rgyud 'di la bstim du gsol// rten rdzas 'di la bstim du gsol// skye 'gro rnams la spel du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char du 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// phywa khu ye/ shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma// dkar mo zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// shar gyi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /lho yi sgo ma zhags pa ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma// lho yi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir= /dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma// dmar mo dbang gi las mdzad ma// nub kyi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig /dgos 'dod char du 'dir phob cig /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir skyobs shig /byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma// sngon mo drag po'i las mdzad ma// byang gi sgo 'di 'byed du gsol// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir=

/dgos 'dod char du 'dir= /tshe dang dpal ni 'dir= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas mda' dar thogs te/ hūm̐/ bdag mdun lha yi thugs ka nas// dbang sdud 'od kyi lcags kyu spros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// tshe lha nor lha gter bdag gi// mkhyen brtse'i nus pa yon tan dang*// khams gsum snod bcud 'jig rten gyi// tshe bcud bsod nams gzi brjid stobs// mi nor longs spyod dbang phyug rnams// khab len dang phrad lcags phye ltar// tshur bsdus bdag mdun lha rnams dang*// g.yang rdzas la bstims sgrub khang gi// phyi nang 'dod dgus gtams par gyur// phywa khu ye/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas// phun sum tshogs pa'i phywa 'dir byon// shar phyogs rgya nag mi yul nas// mi mang 'phel ba'i phywa 'dir khug /lho phyogs rgya gar chos yul nas// dam chos dar ba'i phywa 'dir khug /nub phyogs ge sar dmag yul nas// g.yul las rgyal ba'i phywa 'dir khug /byang phyogs stag gzig nor yul nas// 'dod dgu nor gyi phywa= /steng phyogs 'dod gzugs lha yul nas// gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i phywa= /'og phyogs nor can klu yul nas// rin chen gter gyi phywa= /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal kun 'phel bar mdzod// phyi nang theg pa'i chos kyi phywa= bstan pa rgyas pa'i phywa 'dir= /bde ba'i sar phyin thar pa'i phywa// mkhas btsun grub pa'i phywa 'dir= /tshe dpal mnga' thang 'dod pa'i phywa// srid pa'i phun tshogs phywa 'dir khug /rin chen 'bru dbyig nor gyi phywa// ci 'dod 'byung ba'i phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// rigs bzang mi 'chad mi yi phywa// dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i phywa 'dir khug

/rta mang 'phel ba rta yi phywa// 'gro mgyogs bzhon pa'i phywa 'dir= /khyu mang 'phel ba gnag gi phywa// grangs med phyugs kyi phywa 'dir= /gang 'dod 'jo ba bzhon ma'i phywa// 'o bcud mang 'dzin phywa 'dir= /ro bcud smin pa 'bru tshogs phywa// lo legs 'bru 'phel phywa 'dir= /ngo tsha gcer skyob bgo ba'i phywa// dro 'jam bde ster phywa 'dir= /lus srog 'tsho byed zas kyi phywa// ro bcud mngar ba'i phywa 'dir= /mi phyed rang srung go mtshon phywa// dgra las rgyal byed phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// sra zhing brtan pa sa yi phywa// theg pa che ba'i phywa 'dir khug /rlan zhing gsher ba chu yi phywa// rgyun mi chad pa'i phywa 'dir khug /tsha zhing sreg pa me yi phywa// smin par byed pa'i phywa 'dir khug /yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi phywa// stobs dang ldan pa'i phywa 'dir khug /phywa 'dir ma pham g.yang du byon// g.yang 'dir ma nyams bskyab tu gsol// sbyin bdag dpal ni 'phel bar mdzod// 'pho 'gyur bral ba go 'phang phywa// ri rgyal lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /kun tu gsal ba snyan pa'i phywa// nyi zla lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /khyab bdag chen po dbang gi phywa// nam mkha' lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /mi zad 'phel ba dpal 'byor phywa// dbyar mtsho lta bu'i phywa 'dir khug /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun nas// bde dga' dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa// nyi ma bzhin du lham mer byon// zla ba bzhin du gsal ler byon// na bun bzhin du thibs ser byon// sbrang char bzhin du sil ler byon// de ring sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// tshe dang bsod nams rigs brgyud 'khor// nor phyugs longs spyod thams cad ni// 'phel zhing rtag tu brling bar mdzod// de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/ phye mar mda' dar gtor ma/

spyan gzigs sogs sbyin bdag pho mo gang yod la lag stong ma lus par 'dzin du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis gter bum thogs te/ brda sprod med kyang rung mod/ spro na 'di skad brjod/ 'o khyed rang rnams dngos grub blang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum pa 'di nyid srid pa gsum gyi phywa g.yang dge legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mi zad pa'i gter nam mkha'i mdzod lta bur gyur pa'i dbus su mgon po yid bzhin nor bu 'khor mkha' 'gro nor bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe lha nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gsal ba de dag khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i rkyen gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi sku'i cha dang zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag gi kha dang bshang lam dang*/ ne'u le rnams las rin po che sna tshogs pa lhug lhug babs/ bum pa'i nang gi phywa rdzas rnams las 'dod dgu longs spyod kyi char chen po phab nas dngos grub tu stsal bas/ khyed rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams stobs dang gzi brjid la sogs pa rgyas par byas/ gnas khang dang lung pa thams cad zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil dbyangs dang bcas pas/ phywa khu ye/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// tshe sbyin nor sbyin lha yi tshogs// myur mdzad mgon po thugs rje can// mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin 'jig rten skyong*// thams cad bdag la brtser dgongs nas// deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po la// lus la mi shigs dngos grub stsol// ngag la 'gag med dngos grub stsol// sems la 'khrul med dngos grub stsol// yon tan zad med dngos grub stsol// phrin las mi nub dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// bde skyid ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol// mi nor 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// 'khor 'bangs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// snyan grags rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// lo phyugs legs pa'i dngos grub stsol// rin chen 'bru 'phel dngos grub stsol// longs spyod rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol// mnga' ris yangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// dge chos 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// ci bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub kyis// sbyin bdag 'di la dbang bskur ro// da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/

a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum du reg cing lag tu sbyin te dbang bskur/ gtor ma'i zas sna sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams las cung zad re 'gyed/ de nas 'byor pa rgyas pa'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs re re nas thogs te/ phywa khu ye/ kun la dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phywa// dbang gis bsgyur ba'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ tsakra rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ mun sel 'dod 'byung nor bu'i phywa// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ ma ṇi rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ thams cad kun bskyed btsun mo'i phywa// mdzes sdug dpal gyi bkra shis stsol// oṃ wastī rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ phyi nang don grub blon po'i phywa// che srid brtan pa'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ ma hā tā rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ theg chen stobs chen glang po'i phywa// stobs chen zil gnon bkra shis stsol// oṃ hasti rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog phywa// bde chen bgrod pa'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ a shwa rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon phywa// bdud las rgyal ba'i bkra shis stsol// oṃ khaṅga rat+na maṅga la bha wa tu swā hā/ mi dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// rin chen sna bdun bkra shis mchog /deng 'dir bdag cag 'khor bcas la// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo// de nas yon mchod thams cad gtang rag gi tshogs la rol pa ni/ sngar bshams pa'i tshogs rdzas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs phud dang po snod gcig tu chab kyis bran te/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs tshigs bcad kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog la dbul/ gnyis pa gtor ma rnams kha gsos la chab bran/ gu ru ma hā kā la sogs gtor sngags dang*/

oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis mdun bskyed gtso 'khor la dbul/ de nas dpon slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa la drangs te longs spyad/ slob dpon gyi lhag ma chang dang chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod la gtsang sar dor ro// sbyin bdag rang gnas su btang la/ mchod pa kha gsos te rjes chog gong bzhin bya/ bum pa sogs sgrub rten rnams mdzod phug tu sgrom bu la sogs par 'jog cing bkra shis brjod do// rnam gzhag spyi dang mi 'gal 'don brjod tshig /stabs bde lhur byas cho ga 'di spel ba'i// lhag bsam 'od brgyas 'gro ba'i dpal 'phel zhing*// dge ba byang chub chen po'i rgyur smin shog /ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bum pa'i rten la brten nas phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga rin chen don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni brang ti 'jam pa'i dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan legs pa'i 'byung gnas dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' lung gyen zlog ma spobs par 'don brjod stabs bde ba lhur blangs te rgyal khams pa ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer zhes bod pas dpal lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
